data.name: Mashooq
data.gender_notes: Mashooq is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mashooq is an Arabic name that signifies being deeply loved or cherished. It is often associated with the concept of being the beloved one. The name Mashooq carries the meaning “Beloved, Lover, Adored” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mashooq usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved, lover, adored and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Sufi tradition, Mashooq refers to the beloved God or the ultimate reality that one strives to attain through spiritual love and devotion.
data.etymology: Mashooq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beloved, Lover, Adored.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mashooq total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: ماشوق
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الشوق يعني محبوب أو مرغوب فيه
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من الشوق، يعني الشخص الذي يولد الشوق إليه، محبوب، مرغوب فيه، يتميز بالجمال أو الأخلاق الحميدة، وقد ورد في بعض الأحاديث النبوية الشريفة ذكر الشوق لله تعالى وللجنّة، مما يعطي للاسم قيمة روحانية

in_urdu.name: ماشوق
in_urdu.meaning: محبوب، پیارا، آرزو شدہ، شوق کا مرکز
in_urdu.long_meaning: ماشوق کا مطلب ہے محبوب یا پیارا، جو شخص شوق کا مرکز ہوتا ہے، یہ نام اسلامی روایات میں بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے، خاص طور پر جب کسی کی شخصیت یا خصائص انکساری ہو

in_hindi.long_meaning: माशूक नाम का अर्थ है प्रियतम या प्रिय, जो व्यक्ति आकर्षण का केंद्र होता है, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी प्रचलित है, जहां यह किसी प्रियजन या पूज्य व्यक्ति को संदर्भित करता है

in_pashto.name: ماشوق
in_pashto.meaning: مينه والى، محبوب، د شوق ځاى

data.cultural_impact: The name Mashooq holds deep cultural significance in Islamic societies, primarily in the context of Sufism or Islamic mysticism. In Sufi practices, the term Mashooq is often used to refer to the mystic's beloved, who is usually considered to be Allah or the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him. This deep emotional connection between the seeker and the beloved is emphasized in Sufi teachings, leading to a profound sense of devotion and love.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mashooq holds great significance in emphasizing the intimate relationship between the human soul and God. This name reaffirms the belief that God is not distant and unapproachable, but rather intimately involved in every aspect of human life. Mashooq also serves as a reminder of the importance of maintaining a constant state of love, gratitude, and devotion towards God. By embracing the spiritual meaning of this name, one can deepen their connection with the divine and cultivate a more meaningful and fulfilling spiritual journey.
